Skill `terraform-style-guide`.
Roles: `agent`.
Tool `author_terraform_files` (owner `agent`): via `write`; adds `terraform_code_follows_style`, `file_structure_standard`, `variables_documented_and_typed`, `outputs_documented`, `naming_conventions_followed`, `version_constraints_pinned`.
Tool `format_terraform_code` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `terraform_code_follows_style`; adds `formatted_with_terraform_fmt`.
Tool `validate_terraform_configuration` (owner `agent`): via `bash`; requires `formatted_with_terraform_fmt`; adds `validated_with_terraform_validate`, `formatting_and_validation_done`.
Tool `review_terraform_code` (owner `agent`): via `read`; adds `terraform_code_follows_style`, `file_structure_standard`, `variables_documented_and_typed`, `outputs_documented`, `naming_conventions_followed`, `version_constraints_pinned`.
Initially true: none.
Goal: all of (`terraform_code_follows_style`, `file_structure_standard`, `variables_documented_and_typed`, `outputs_documented`, `naming_conventions_followed`, `version_constraints_pinned`, `formatting_and_validation_done`).
Protocol: none.
Behaviour of `agent`:
  - select one of:
    - branch `generate_configuration`:
      - use `author_terraform_files`.
      - select one of:
        - branch `run_validation_tools`:
          - use `format_terraform_code`.
          - use `validate_terraform_configuration`.
        - branch `skip_validation`: none.
    - branch `review_configuration`:
      - use `review_terraform_code`.
